name: print-social-customer-feedback-glass-cards-phone-mockup-purple-glow
title: Customer feedback shown as frosted-glass testimonial cards inside a phone mockup on a purple glow
whatItIs: A phone outline mockup on a dark purple radial glow, with two overlapping frosted-glass testimonial cards each showing a circular customer photo, name, five-star rating and a short quote, plus standard Instagram action icons below.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and modern; presenting reviews as glass cards inside a phone frame makes social proof feel like a live, native app experience.
techniques: Overlap two testimonial cards for a layered, dynamic feel.
Frame testimonials inside a phone outline for an in-app feel.
Glow the background radially to draw focus to the centre cards.

vocabulary.definition: A card featuring a customer's photo, rating and quote.
Light fading outward from a central point.
